name: broker-redeliveries-exhausted
description: If the ActiveMQ RedeliveryPolicy allows fewer redeliveries than the flow needs (maximumRedeliveries=3, connector check disabled), deliveries 1-4 all roll back and ActiveMQ moves the message to ActiveMQ.DLQ unchanged; topic1 gets nothing. Module config: jms.max-redelivery=-1, activemq.redelivery-policy.maximum-redeliveries=3.

source.reference: jms-message-rollback-and-redelivery/src/main/app/jms-redelivery.xml (redeliveryPolicy bean on amqFactory; choice succeeds only when JMSXDeliveryCount==5); ActiveMQ Classic RedeliveryPolicy docs (after maximumRedeliveries the client poison-acks and the broker sends the message to ActiveMQ.DLQ)
